mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saving_option ( saving_product_id, interest_rate_type, reserve_type, save_term, base_interest_rate, max_interest_rate ) VALUES ( #{savingProductId}, #{interestRateType}, #{reserveType}, #{saveTerm}, #{baseInterestRate}, #{maxInterestRate} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_interest_rate = new.base_interest_rate, max_interest_rate = new.max_interest_rate
